author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - Consul-k8s cross-namespace ACL binding bypass (CVE-2026-110720): ACL binding rules let a pod/service account influence bindings outside its namespace and obtain elevated Consul ACL privileges.

author: ThreatWire_
text: A BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day was used from 29 Aug. CISA added CVE-2026-102764 to KEV on 16 Oct. Self-hosted <=26.2.3: confirm the BT26-05-RS patch; check off-box logs if exposed while unpatched.

author: OhioValleyEV
text: Python still trusted leaked security certificates, so someone on your network could fake a secure website. Rated Critical (CVE-2026-115557). Fix: update to Python's Oct 26 releases.

author: ArcelieFernand2
text: Microsoft has linked Storm-0940 activity against Microsoft 365 to compromised credentials associated with ConnectWise Cloud Backup.

author: cryptomediazone
text: Railway: after a cloud breach, a thief drained $371,000 from 200+ crypto wallets whose keys were stored on Railway. The thefts began before Railway warned anyone.

author: BleepinComputer
text: CISA has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday.

author: vuln_tracker
text: PHP2Shell is now in CISA KEV. CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 were added on Oct 26, federal due date Oct 29. Public exploit code is out, and Amazon saw probing from Oct 17, before the fix was public. Also affects Palo Alto PAN-OS and Panorama.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Supermicro server BMCs: CVE-2026-18450 (CVSS 9.8) - the BMC doesn't correctly enforce integrity and encryption requirements for IPMI commands, so crafted packets may inject IPMI commands into an active session.

author: ronvo2000
text: Millions of hacking attempts hit PHP sites worldwide: two critical RCE flaws in PHP (php2shell, CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619), discovered using AI and present for years. Cloudflare recorded thousands of attempts.

author: cubillas888
text: MCP server risk: Pillar Security says opencode on Windows and WSL could run an attacker's code during remote MCP OAuth sign-in. Fixed in 1.18.33 (Sept 28), with no advisory or CVE.

author: cubillas888
text: Data breach at Bubble: it confirms an attacker accessed plugin metadata, including private API keys, and downloaded data from apps whose editor was already public. Bubble believes the attacker is contained and has no evidence of private app data access. Forensics continue.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: One Brotli decoder bug. Node.js, .NET and Python all exposed. CVE-2026-111497 (Node2Shell / HTTP2Shell) is an out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder. A crafted compressed stream can corrupt memory, leading to crashes, data leaks or unauthenticated RCE.

author: CryptoThreadsX
text: Passport (Foundation) data leak: over 23,000 phishing emails sent after attackers exploited compromised Cloudflare API keys and old customer data that was never fully deleted.

author: BursaMatus
text: GMO Internet's FX cloud desktops (Onamae Desktop Cloud) were hacked: 26,739 servers at risk, saved trading logins stolen, rogue trades at OANDA and others. GMO won't pay the $50M demand; NHK says attackers leaked one client's data.

author: EmunaEliran
text: HashiCorp Consul: 4 new CVEs. One lets a caller with no ACL token pull a service's cached mesh certificate and private key from the agent. CVE-2026-105608 (CVSS 8.8): service:write without mesh:write can inject raw Envoy config into a sidecar.

author: mikejt4
text: GoAhead embedded web server: FoxIO detailed three TLS bugs depending on the crypto library; on the OpenSSL path a CRL loads but CRL checking is never enabled, so revoked mTLS certs still work.

author: Saurois
text: GMO's hack escalated: update on the Onamae.com Desktop Cloud breach (VPS used for FX trading bots); GMO says the suspected attacker threatened to leak customer data and launch ransomware, and told customers to unplug their PCs.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Dahua IP cameras in Ukraine are being hijacked at scale via predictable serial numbers, auth bypass CVEs, and P2P cloud relay abuse (Easy4IP), with Russian actors using the footage for real-time military intelligence.

author: SeafealHear
text: Microsoft reports a compromised application was used in attempts to reach more than 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants; that does not establish data exfiltration. How quickly can you identify and revoke the application's access?

author: pdnuclei_bot
text: CVE-2026-105134 - critical: AhsayCBS <= 10.3.4 - Unauthenticated RCE (command injection). Nuclei template released.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack on GitHub and npm: JFrog says 42 real GitHub repos across 11 owners were armed with execution hooks for AI coding assistants and IDEs, tied to the testmetest npm campaign. Review hook and config files before opening cloned repos in an assistant.

author: dailycve
text: Anthropic Claude Code, Privilege Escalation, CVE-2026-25725 (critical)

author: Hecadium
text: PHP2Shell is no longer theoretical. CISA added both flaws (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) to KEV. US agencies have until Oct 29 to patch. Censys still sees ~32.5M PHP services on affected versions.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-30612 in the abandoned Time4Popcorn updater enabled silent RCE via unsigned HTTP updates on millions of devices. Check for Updater.exe under Program Files and PT.updd at /Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/ on macOS.

author: zeeshankghouri
text: VeloCloud CVE-2026-114625: low-priv user to SQL injection to superuser operator to privileged internal functions. Actively exploited. CISA KEV.

author: itsMikeKipruto
text: Two critical Wasmtime sandbox escapes, both CVSS 9.9: CVE-2026-115889 (all architectures) and CVE-2026-115893 (ARM64). Both in Cranelift, Wasmtime's default compiler. A malicious WebAssembly module could escape its sandbox.

author: itsMikeKipruto
text: 953 online stores compromised, mostly Magento. The campaign exploited PolyShell (CVE-2026-48356) and SessionReaper (CVE-2025-54236) to gain access, then injected JavaScript loaders designed to evade security scanners.

author: mergenewsapp
text: GitLab fixed a critical RCE vulnerability (CVE-2026-110264) in self-managed instances. Update immediately to prevent unauthenticated code execution.

author: eapyk
text: Newly disclosed MCP vulnerability: on October 25 a security advisory revealed an SSRF bypass in mcp-server-fetch, a tool that allows AI agents to fetch URLs, because two components interpret the same URL differently.

author: codesprint_
text: Three new RCE advisories for the official MCP Inspector. Two rated Critical, one High. All three lead to code execution with your privileges. Fixed in 1.0.3 and 2.12.0.

author: chris_uk2026
text: CISA has officially added the AI-discovered PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog. Active wild exploits are fully confirmed.

author: yogsec
text: Daily CVE Roundup Oct 27: CVE-2026-111497 (Google Brotli / Node.js / Bun) CVSS 7.3, buffer overflow in the Brotli decoder allows remote unauthenticated attackers...

author: isectech_
text: New CISA KEV: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQLi CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9, actively exploited). Patch on-prem VCO to 5.2.3.18+ / 6.1.3.10+ / 6.4.2.12+ now.

author: gastronomy
text: Where AI Vulnerability Discovery Harnesses Go Quiet: LLM-based vulnerability discovery harnesses can miss real, reachable vulnerabilities because of how the harness around the model is built.

author: showxlate
text: Security Report: Prompt-Injection-to-RCE architectural vulnerability plus an active social engineering campaign harvesting credentials and biometric data via a malicious repository with inflated stars.

author: VeduisWeb
text: Gheist is running an ongoing supply chain attack that uses GitHub tokens to pull cloud secrets, harvesting credentials and sensitive data from thousands of developer repositories.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) is now actively exploited. A honeypot caught confirmed RCE on Apache mod_php with PHP 8.4.26, one release short of the fix.

author: ApplSec
text: Apple pushed additional updates for a zero-day that may have been actively exploited. CVE-2026-86950 (CoreGraphics) additional patches: iOS and iPadOS 18.7.11.

author: TheRegister
text: LiteLLM's postmortem traces its supply chain attack to a master key exposed on GitHub in May and never revoked. Five months later an attacker exploited it to help poison a software release.

author: awacinocom
text: Plex2Shell: four Plex Media Server flaws chained into one attack (CVSS 9.8) let attackers run code on internet-facing servers without a login. CISA lists them as actively exploited.
